questions.question: Give three (3) ways you might vary the ‘strength’ of a coffee drink to suit individual customer preferences.
guidance: This is potentially problematic as there is no standard for coffee strength and the term itself means different things to different people (to some it refers to caffeine level, to some it refers to roast, to others it means mouthfeel of the product) – so with this in mind:
Use a lighter roast for a lighter intensity requirement
Serve a double ristretto for someone who wants a strong coffee
Recommend a blend with higher ratio of Robusta beans for someone who say they want it strong
Add water (such as ‘long black’) where the person wants weaker coffee
Serve 15ml in standard size (weak), 30ml in standard size (standard strength),30ml Doppio ristretto or 60ml Doppio espresso (strong or double shot)

questions.question: How does ‘ambient humidity’ affect the quality of espresso coffee?
guidance: Coffee is hydroscopic meaning it absorbs water
As humidity increases the grind absorbs water from the atmosphere making the grounds denser and more compacted and making it more difficult for the water to pass through during extraction
This means as humidity rises you should alter the grind to make it coarser, and as humidity falls this should be made finer – monitoring extraction time can help indicated changes in ambient humidity

questions.question: Explain the primary reason for changes in flow texture during extraction.
guidance: Inconsistent tamping of grounds in the basket can cause uneven distribution of grind into the basket when dosing. It means some parts of the cake are being over-extracted and others are being under-extracted (‘channelling’). This can be rectified by tapping the handle to settle the grounds, or ‘grooming’ the top of the dose.
Another possibility is that the shower screen may be clogged and needs cleaning or replacing.

questions.question: Changes in the humidity is one reason for adjusting the grind.  What are three (3) other reasons when you may need to adjust the grind?
guidance: The grind may need to be adjusted:
due to blade wear and when replacing blades in the grinder
as a result of unacceptable variations in extraction time
when the type of beans is changed
when the quality of coffee changes, for example, bitter or too strong coffee may be the result of too fine grounds, so the ground needs to be made coarser; and too weak coffee may need finer grounds.

questions.question: What is a common way to adjust a grinder?
guidance: Moving the collar – usually clockwise makes it coarser and anti-clockwise makes it finer
answer_points: Moving the collar – usually clockwise makes it coarser and anti-clockwise makes it finer

questions.question: How does the water flow rate impact the quality of espresso?
guidance: It impacts the extraction rate – high water flow rate increases extraction rate and low water flow decreased extraction rate
answer_points: It impacts the extraction rate – high water flow rate increases extraction rate and low water flow decreased extraction rate

questions.question: What are two (2) common causes that affect the flow rates in espresso machines?
guidance: A faulty pump on the machine or blockages caused by build-up of coffee grounds
The size of the grind – too fine grind, may slow down the flow rate, while too coarse grind may result in faster flow rate
The tamping pressure applied to the ground coffee
The water temperature and pressure – hot water or high pressure may result in faster flow, while cold water or low pressure may slow down the rate
answer_points: A faulty pump on the machine or blockages caused by build-up of coffee grounds
The size of the grind – too fine grind, may slow down the flow rate, while too coarse grind may result in faster flow rate
The tamping pressure applied to the ground coffee
The water temperature and pressure – hot water or high pressure may result in faster flow, while cold water or low pressure may slow down the rate

questions.question: Identify two (2) possible ways to adjust the water pressure on an espresso machine.

Remove any build-up blockages and adjust the water flow rate
answer_points: Adjust the pump pressure using a pressure gauge or adjusting the regulating screw
Remove any build-up blockages and adjust the water flow rate
